$comment: Message catalogues load per route (E07 research R22, E03 T10): a message whose id starts with one of a part's prefixes is in that part, everything else is in core; a part loads when a page under one of its routes opens. Checked by scripts/catalogue-size.mjs.

forumAdmin.$comment: Also on the committee pages, which read a type's quorum sentence, outcome meanings and term words.

papers.$comment: A paper sent to a committee (Phase 4 E02 T4): its status and timeline, on the committee pages and on the memo page.

meetings.$comment: Meetings (Phase 4 E03 T6): the committee page's Meetings tab, a meeting's page, My meetings, and the My meetings card on the home page and the next meeting on the My committees cards.
